examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Default card with a title header and body content in the default slot.

examples.name: Header
examples.summary: An action rendered through the `header` slot stays visible, aligned to the end of the header.

examples.name: Footer
examples.summary: Filling the `footer` slot renders the footer bar with actions or metadata.

examples.name: Flush
examples.summary: Set `padded=false` for edge-to-edge content such as an ItemList with full-width dividers.

examples.name: Page JSON
examples.summary: The same content in the marketing site's page JSON: `Card` is a scene, so a band places it by name in its `scene` slot (here `console-showcase-section` with `variant: "diagram"` and `texture: "none"`, so nothing is painted behind it) and `SitePage` renders the entry with no code. The card body is a text child of the scene.
